global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork, nori seaweed, and menma bamboo shoots. Fresh greens and sliced scallions crown the bowl, set in a patterned ceramic dish against warm wooden tones under soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown color, visible grain pattern, and smooth texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a blue and white patterned rim with a glossy finish and slightly raised, decorative edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth, rich amber liquid, glossy surface with visible bubbles and steam rising from the hot, savory soup.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, slightly curled, with a rough, textured surface and visible veins.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has glossy, caramelized brown edges and tender, layered white and pink meat with visible fat marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, sliced, slightly translucent pieces with visible fibrous texture and faint seasoning.
